findings.title: Real - P1 matches only under the Phase 1 rule for D <= 0, which the run's summary.md does not document
findings.evidence: In OX coin-week CRV 2023-01-09 the week opened exactly at the prior week's high (O = PWH = 0.577, so D_H = 0). Applied literally, the formula puts all four P1H levels at 0.577, the real PWH itself. They touch on the same bar (2023-01-09 00:00) and exit at 0.637, each scoring +1,039.86 bps. That copies the real event four times into the placebo pool. My first pass did this and got OX P1 n = 12,800, P1 gross 3.3035 and real - P1 19.0734, against the run's 12,796, 2.9795 and 19.3974: 0.324 bps apart, outside the 0.1 bps tolerance. The run creates no P1 levels on a side where D <= 0 and keeps the real level. That follows the plan: it defines D_H, D_L > 0, and P1 is a price-shifted control, so it is undefined at zero distance. Phase 2 also says 'P1 as Phase 1', and in Phase 1 both independent implementations chose this rule (implX/summary.md item 4, implY/summary.md item 3, reconcile/reconcile.md 'D <= 0: the real level is scored and that side gets no P1 levels'). With that rule as primary, every number matches. A grep of p2/run/summary.md finds no mention of it. OT has no coin-week with D <= 0.
findings.effect_on_numbers: OX P1 gross mean 2.9795 vs 3.3035 and real - P1 19.40 vs 19.07 (P(diff<=0) = 0.0000 either way; CI [9.82, 28.76] vs [9.58, 28.35]). OT and every OX real-event number are unchanged. No gate changes.
findings.fix: Add one line to the run's summary.md choices list: when D <= 0 on a side, no P1 levels are created on that side and the real level is still scored. Give the count (OX: 1 coin-week, CRV 2023-01-09, H side; OT: 0) and the literal-formula sensitivity (OX real - P1 19.07).

adv.checked:
I reproduced every T row of events_OT (16,848) and events_OX (56,007) with my own loader and engine (check_adv/adv_lib.py), written from the plan text. That covers real, P1 and primary P3; 0 rows only on either side, and gross, level and exit |delta| = 0. The four gating numbers, 4 h n and bootstrap P values match results.json to 7.1e-15, and dropped exits and used coin-weeks match (OT 1,060, OX 3,251). Caveat: I wrote the engine after reading the run's code, so it is separate code but not the blind independent check plan section 6 still owes.

Checks run:
(1) Look-ahead: levels, touches, exits and P1/P3 formulas rebuilt from the bars; the coverage-rule variants; the OX selection recomputed from raw Q4-2021 1d files and checked against the S3 listing and cache provenance.
(2) Fills: touch-bar anatomy (trade beyond L, gaps, within-bar reversals, strict spikes) and the gates under seven fill variants plus the plain high >= L trigger.
(3) Data: thin and zero-volume touch and exit bars, bad-print exits, sweep bars, audit wick weeks, exits in OX flat runs, delisting tails, and OX funding.
(4) Concentration: top 1 % of events, the 5 largest positive / negative / absolute weeks removed with the gates recomputed, crash weeks, leave-one-coin-out.
(5) P1/P3 construction against the plan, plus real - P3 and daily Sharpe recomputed.
Extra: the OT coin list against the plan's own criterion, using 12 public spot pairs downloaded with checksums into check_adv/dl_spot/.

Result: no run defect, and the overall FAIL is robust because OX fails under every variant. OT's pass is fragile: it fails test 1 under a touch-close fill (P 0.0665), L+20 bps (P 0.0495), removal of its 5 best weeks (P 0.0355), or the wider coin set (P 0.0180).

Outputs are in check_adv/: sel_check.json, c1_reproduce.json, c2_fills.json, c3_data.json, c4_concentration.json, c5_funding_p1p3.json, c6_ot_extended.json, c7_misc.json, c8_spike.json, plus the scripts that produce them.
